subject: STABLE api-surface-sonnet #1: events/fences, MSL source, async creation, queue/command/compute/render/blit/texture API, parallel render encoder, indirect compute dispatch, indirect draws (CPU args), binary archive
body:
Host-only; ASan+UBSan PASS of gpu/tests/api_surface_frontend_test.py (events, device/queue/command, MSL-source+async+archive, compute encoder, render/blit/texture, parallel encoder, indirect draw, indirect dispatch; live-object balance 0 after each group). iOS arm64 freestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror compile of compute_frontend.m clean. NOTE: needs the n2mb_clear 'pixel[16]' fix (see board, not mine) - I ran with the test-only stopgap API_PATCH_CLEAR_PIXEL=1 which patches the bridge COPY under gpu/build/api-surface-20261027/host; the texture/other harnesses will smash the stack until the bridge is fixed.
Shared-file edits (all small, anchored): compute_frontend.m (Dispatch fields eventKind/eventValue/eventObject; TeguCommand ivar indirectVerifies; encodeSignalEvent body; 7 execute-loop/prologue lines: event pseudo-job run + reap condition + batch-flag chain breaks + events_flush + indirect_verify; dealloc releases; 3 includes), blit_encoder.inc (fence bodies), render_encoder.inc (ONLY the two indirect-draw method bodies + 1 prototype).
Hashes (compute_frontend.m api_events.inc api_surface.inc api_parallel.inc api_surface_host_test.inc blit_encoder.inc render_encoder.inc test.py): 0f64c40e 75aa5dcd 9c708aab 46cda00b 0b10ecf9 5bde1e77 9ac2232a f9dd6cf6
Ledger: gpu/build/api-surface-20261027/API-SURFACE.md. Remaining (owned elsewhere, posted): cull/fill modes, depth/stencil, GPU-written indirect draw args, buffer-backed textures, stitching/argument buffers.
